decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The proposed change of use from D1 to C3 is considered unacceptable in principle as it would lead to further encroachment of residential uses within the Locally Significant Industrial Area. Although it is recognised that the existing use (D1) is not an industrial use, it is still considered to be an appropriate use which serves the local community. 
As such, the proposed development would fail to comply with DMPD (2016) policies DMI1 and DMC1 and LPEID policies EI1 and EI3.

Reason : 2 - The proposed development would result in the unacceptable loss of a community facility (training centre) within the Borough, directly contrary to DMPD (2016) policy DMC1 which seeks to protect existing community facilities. No satisfactory justification as per the criteria in policy DMC1 has been provided to justify that the loss of a community facility would be acceptable and consistent with DMPD (2016) policy DMC1.

Reason : 3 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
Reason : 4 - INFORMATIVE: The applicant is advised that the submitted drawings are not of high quality and the detailed proposal cannot be fully assessed.
description: Change of use from training centre (Class D1) to residential (Class C3) to provide 2 x 1-bedroom, 1 x 1-bedroom and 1 x 2-bedroom flat.
